entries.title: The Auctioneer Loom
entries.subject: A Signature design for a market hall where robot teams trade tasks by bid.

entries.title: The Consensus Compass
entries.subject: A Signature design for a compass that points a robot team at its agreed value.

entries.title: The Shape-Keeper
entries.subject: A Signature design for a guardian that holds a robot team in formation.

entries.title: The Sweep Planner
entries.subject: A Signature design for a planner that guarantees no ground is left unswept.

entries.title: The Flock Tuner
entries.subject: A Signature design for tuning flocking rules until a robot crowd moves as one.

entries.title: The Safe-Cone Navigator
entries.subject: A Signature design for a navigator that steers only outside collision cones.

entries.title: The Map Stitcher
entries.subject: A Signature design for stitching many small robot maps into one big map.

entries.title: The Link Keeper
entries.subject: A Signature design for a guardian that keeps a robot team's radio graph connected.

entries.title: The Role Wheel
entries.subject: A Signature design for a wheel that spins roles around a robot team as the mission changes.

entries.title: The Grid Runner

entries.title: The Node Choir

entries.title: The Swarm Whisperer

entries.title: The Shelf River

entries.title: The Rubble Listener
entries.subject: A Signature design for a listener that hears survivors through robot ears.

entries.title: The Field Gardener
entries.subject: A Signature design for a gardener that tends every plant in a field individually.

entries.title: The Deep Lane Planner
entries.subject: A Signature design for planning survey lanes for underwater robot teams.

entries.title: The Sky Painter
entries.subject: A Signature design for painting pictures in the sky with drone teams.

entries.title: The Course Layer
entries.subject: A Signature design for laying courses of bricks with robot teams on building sites.

entries.title: The Ward Runner
entries.subject: A Signature design for a runner that carries medicine through hospital corridors.
